newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic invests in Vista Medical.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic invests in Vista Medical.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Wednesday it made an equity investment of an undisclosed amount in Vista Medical Technologies Inc.
Medtronic and Vista also agreed to collaborate in promoting Vista's advanced visualization systems for minimally invasive cardiothoracic surgery in the United States.
Medtronic also will become the exclusive distributor of these systems in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
Vista's Series 8000 Visualization and Information System is expected to be available in the spring of 1997.

"We look forward to a progressive relationship with Vista, and we are confident that their state-of-the-art technologies will substantially complement Medtronic product lines for minimally invasive surgery," Philip Laughlin, president of Medtronic Cardiac Surgery, said in a statement.

John Lyon, president of Vista Medical, said the alliance with Medtronic will accelerate his company's product launch in Europe. It also will provide enhanced access and substantial added value to cardiac surgeons in the United States as they develop minimally invasive surgical programs.
Medtronic specializes in implantable and invasive therapies.
